description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_GetAutoloadFilters, which extends another class and provides a method to retrieve autoload filter configurations within the Smarty templating system.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetAutoloadFilters
classes.description: Provides functionality to get autoload filters in Smarty, extending the autoload filter setting class.

methods.name: getAutoloadFilters
methods.description: Retrieves the autoload filters, optionally filtered by type, from the Smarty object.
